about: Dungkar Gönpa on the spur (tools/town/monastery.py; M2 sprint 13). `houses`: the monks' houses, each [id, type M1, M2 or M3, seed (the kit's variant), pos (its middle and its pad's level, the town grid), rot_deg (its front's bearing, down the fall line), footprint, row, apron (its level ground's margin round it: pads.py's footprint); an M2's pad, its yard's ground with its own: x, y, width, depth; an M3's kit and its khamtsen]. `buildings`: the four khamtsen halls (MON-26a to d), placed as the houses are, with their kit and pad (the portico's ground); MON-11's granary range MON-11G and the dogs' kennel MON-38, each on the median of its own ground (M3 sprint 3, step 4). `pads`: the halls' at the middle of their own ground (pads.py RAISED, MOVED and TURNED, world/town.gd monastery_pads), with their far form's kit; `was` chapter 02's level, `moved_from` its place. `follow`: on the ground as it is. `walls`: the wall MON-21's runs on the ground, each its height and its points at 1 m (a free wall of tools/town/walls.py, as Hejie's). tools/terrain/pads.py cuts the pads, tools/town/walls.py walls their podia, world/town.gd places them. Regenerated with the terrain.
